rec: INCLUDED AS A WARNING, not a recommendation. I checked the London and Amsterdam course listings directly: Abbey Road Institute offers Advanced Diplomas and masterclasses only — there is no master's degree at any campus I could verify, and no awarding body is named. For someone who already holds a BSc, paying private-academy fees for an unaccredited diploma is a poor use of money and yields no qualification that European systems recognise at level 7, no automatic student-visa pathway comparable to a degree, and no progression to doctoral study.
